title: A finite monomorphism of schemes is a closed immersion
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Suppose $f$ is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and is a monomorphism, meaning that $f\circ a=f\circ b$ implies $a=b$ for every scheme $T$ and morphisms $a,b:T\to X$. Then $f$ is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion].
